_doc: Floating enemy health bar styles, keyed by map. The client (client/enemy_bars.gd) resolves a map to a style: first by map id (`by_map`), then by the map's atmosphere (`by_atmosphere`), then `default`. Each style has a base look plus optional `elite` and `boss` overrides (a richer frame for a goblin knight / the Chief and the HUD boss bar). Colours are RGBA arrays 0..1; a null colour means 'take the matching InkUi token' (resolved in code so a chosen theme still drives the frame). Readability note: every bar sits on a dark back plate with a dark outline so it reads on both the bright golden ground and the dark ink ground from the steep camera; meaning never rests on colour alone (the frame shape and the notch mark carry it).

goblin._doc: Stage-1 goblin family. Fits Night Brass (tarnished bronze frame, dark glassy back) but feels goblin/wild: a crude lashed-plank frame, a mossy-to-rust fill (not the player's clean red), a notch 'fang' mark on the left cap. Works on the golden valley and the ink maps.

elite._doc: Goblin knight: a richer, brighter bronze frame with studs, so the elite reads apart from the grunts at a glance.

boss._doc: The Goblin Chief and the HUD boss bar on a goblin map: the richest frame (studs plus corner teeth) in warm bronze-gold, a deeper mossy fill, a bone/skull mark.

brass._doc: The default for every other map: the plain Night Brass family. Frame and low-HP colours come from the InkUi tokens (null), the fill is the HUD HP red, so unthemed maps keep the current look and a chosen theme still drives it.

_tiers_doc: Which bar tier an enemy type uses (base look if unlisted). Keeps elite/boss framing data-driven and out of fighter_view.
